title: On a running test install with planner=off and an empty board for an hour, no planner draft is filed
description: Starts a real temporary Postgres control plane with an empty board and empty-board alarm held for an hour after setting master config planner=off with the operator-agent identity; running coordination cycles across the hour launches no planner session and files no draft, and master status shows the planner as off with who set it.

steps.name: running test install with planner=off and an empty board for an hour files no planner draft
